What is Static Site SEO Checklist Generator?

A static site SEO checklist is a pre-publish review for HTML sites, GitHub Pages projects, static blogs, documentation sites, and small tool websites. It helps catch missing titles, broken internal links, missing canonical tags, missing social tags, and other small issues that can reduce search visibility.

How to use this tool

  1. Choose the site type that best matches your project.
  2. Enter the public domain or final site URL.
  3. Select the features your site uses, such as multilingual pages or structured data.
  4. Copy the generated checklist and review each item before publishing.

What you can use it for

  • Review a static site before pushing to GitHub Pages.
  • Create a reusable checklist for blog post publishing.
  • Avoid missing common SEO tags on small websites.

Common mistakes

  • Publishing pages without unique titles and descriptions.
  • Leaving important pages out of navigation or sitemap files.
  • Adding multilingual pages without canonical and hreflang planning.

FAQ

Questions about Static Site SEO Checklist Generator

Is this checklist enough for a full SEO audit?

No. It is a launch checklist for common static site issues. A full audit also checks crawl data, search performance, content quality, backlinks, and technical logs.

Can I use this for a blog?

Yes. Select the blog option and include blog-specific checks such as internal links, image alt text, and social preview tags.

Does a GitHub Pages site need SEO tags?

Yes. Static hosting does not remove the need for titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, internal links, and indexable HTML.
